details: The package's preinstall hook (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from the official oven-sh/bun GitHub release and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB obfuscated script (math_init.js) at install time. The script is obfuscated with a large encoded string array and a custom decoder, so its behaviour is hidden. The package also depends on @or-sdk/base, a known-malicious dependency, and its runtime code is a thin wrapper that imports from it. Installing this package executes the obfuscated payload on every install.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
